annotations.title: Get Google Search Console hourly performance

description: MisarSEO's own retained HOURLY Search Console totals for the connected property — the hourly counterpart to get_search_console_performance's daily archive. FREE (no credits) and makes NO call to Google: reads MisarSEO's own Postgres. Unlike the daily archive, a wider date range does not mean more history — Google itself only offers roughly the trailing 8-10 days of hourly data, and the nightly sync only ever fetches that same window, so a startDate earlier than it simply returns nothing for the days outside it. Each row's `hour` is 0-23 in Search Console's own America/Los_Angeles reporting hour.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_search_console_hourly_performance
